SECONDS = the time limit. A less trained brewer (his Brewers.csv Success %) gets a harder game. ART = a folder of pictures (see the manual); a missing picture is drawn plainly. Lose = the batch is spoiled. No row = no game. Tuning.csv brewery_minigames false turns them all off.
